proposed_capability: P141 strategic review followed by Moonwake Fifth Gear: strengthen the existing opt-in character-creation journey with a deterministic goal/context-aware starting skill route and first-day decision priorities, surfaced through the existing first-run CLI and GUI without attempting live CAS edits.
player_save_control_impact: Plan generation only. No saved character or save reading, automatic CAS clicks, trait or skill cheats, queue intervention, game files, Mods writes, input watchers or OS settings. Explicit double-click launches game only; player owns New Game, character details and all in-game effects.
expected_outcome: A deterministic, bounded advisory route for initial skills and first-day needs/income/skill/career/leisure decisions, adjusted by optional urgent needs, income pressure and player favorite skill. Render in first-run GUI and CLI, preserve four existing goals, preserve save policy, and test abstention and tie determinism.
negative_tests: No action or claim to apply CAS choices or grant skills
Unknown preferred skill and unknown goal fail closed
Income pressure favors immediately earning before training
Existing mode remains a save-safe player handoff
Stable deterministic skill tie ordering and no mutation of global scores
No EA process launch in offline planning
No new input adapters, hooks, daemon, or telemetry
rollback_path: Revert isolated PR for this feature; previous first_run plan and chooser remain available and no game or save state is altered.
unresolved_unknowns: Current EA patch/pack and real CAS UI not observed through GitHub
True optimal skill paths depend on player's build, traits, packs, game context and local observation
Host-specific CAS effect adapter requires separate P08 with explicit effect permissions
decision_rationale: P141 compared staged advisory progression (survives and cheap to evaluate), unobserved CAS click automation (deferred to local host proof), and automatic perfect skill/cheat builds (rejected as player-override and gameplay authority violation). Use the existing first_run owner, preserve BI-002 hunger-first runtime gate and issue #201 local Windows proof.
